text: I really love Habit Hero, and so does my kid! 💯 Thank you so much for creating exactly what we needed. Everything is great, and I hope it stays that way! My only disappointment is the reward icons. My kid chose each one with me during the parent session, and we were excited to match them with the rewards, but in the kid session, the icons looked almost the same. Since rewards are the best part for kids, more variety would make it even better!
author: fadwa mnasser
